from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u003/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    src = [row[left:right + 1] for row in grid[top:bottom + 1]]
    sh, sw = len(src), len(src[0])
    out = [[src[sh - 1 - c][sw - 1 - r] for c in range(sh)] for r in range(sw)]

    outside = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != 0 and not (top <= r <= bottom and left <= c <= right)]
    inside_colors = {v for row in src for v in row if v != 0}
    missing = [(r, c, v) for r, c, v in outside if v not in inside_colors]
    if missing:
        mr, mc, mv = missing[0]
        anchors = [(r, c, v) for r, c, v in outside if v in inside_colors and v != mv]
        # The missing marker extends from the matching interior marker along the
        # same straight segment as the three outside markers.
        ar, ac, av = next(((r, c, v) for r, c, v in anchors if r == mr or c == mc), anchors[0])
        inner = next(( (r, c) for r in range(sh) for c in range(sw) if src[r][c] == av))
        ir, ic = sw - 1 - inner[1], sh - 1 - inner[0]
        rr, cc = ir + mr - ar, ic + mc - ac
        if 0 <= rr < len(out) and 0 <= cc < len(out[0]):
            out[rr][cc] = mv
    return out
'''
program_path=program_dir/'task-57a13ff1.py'
program_path.write_text(code)
print(program_path)
